From the Juvo custom-logic audit session (10-13, owner-approved): commit 92981d7f on LOCAL main (docs only, NOT pushed; you decide when, mind the Wed-evening demo freeze). It holds:
(1) docs/10-architecture/juvo-custom-logic-inventory.md. This is our CYA read of all four Juvo repos, including employer-web-portal, which the 10-05 brief missed. Full reports are in docs/90-evidence/juvo-cya-2026-10-12/. §1 lists 7 items before the switch, §2 the new security holes (Mike, privately), §5 the questions for Mike. The owner is sending it to Mike now.
(2) heroku-go-live-checklist.md §2 A: the two Mike questions are answered from the code.
  - No Juvo withdraw call works: PUT /api/v3/connections/:id/revoke 500s (it calls a missing class), and the real class needs employer permission. This answers lane B's BQ-527-1 wait: a withdraw is ours-only until Mike fixes it.
  - A pending connection never expires.
  §2 G gains a test-employer pre-check: role set (temp-access employers are never notified), has logged into the portal (email needs it), the brand HAS A LOGO (without one, GET /api/v2/conversations 500s for the seeker's whole inbox), and billing that won't charge a real card on accept.
(3) Two DRAFT specs for lane B, at the owner's word: FS-539 and FS-540. I took the numbers because they were free on main, every branch and every worktree and you were down. Confirm or renumber.
  - FS-539: an accept counts only when a second poll still shows it. Juvo commits the accept, then charges the card and rolls it back on failure; mirror.ts decide() freezes on first sight. 1 file, ~30 LOC. BQ-539-1, pick (a).
  - FS-540: a reply into a chat Juvo's staff closed is refused, via one GET /api/v3/connections/:id before add_message (that endpoint never renders a logo). 3 files, ~60 LOC. BQ-540-1 and BQ-540-2, picks (a).
  Both need a critic round and the owner's BQ answers; route them to lane B for before the switch.
(4) The tree's modified vitest.config.mts and untracked docs/50-requirements/drafts/ are not mine; left alone.
